items.subEn: Capricorn degrees: Mars-driven discipline, ambition, and structure; Aquarian degrees: community, networks, and coordination
items.subZh: 摩羯座度数：火星驱动的纪律、野心与结构；水瓶座度数：社群、网络与协调

items.nameZh: 将财富重新定义为节奏
items.subEn: Treat wealth as synchronization with cycles and timing — not a literal prediction of money
items.subZh: 将财富理解为与周期和时机同步，而非对金钱的字面预测

items.subEn: Ask: where in life does this person keep time, set tempo, or coordinate a group?
items.subZh: 问：这个人在生活中哪里掌控节奏、设定节拍或协调群体？

items.subZh: 将八神读作整体中的和谐——繁荣是共同协调，而非个人积累
